result.rationale: This block gives the forcing equation and the resulting 0.64°C/0.81°C values; recomputing with ln vs log10 reveals the log10 was used instead of ln, exposing the error on its own.

System identifies that paper used log10 instead of the natural log (ln) specified in the IPCC formula, causing temperature values to be off by factor ln10≈2.303 — exactly matching the annotated defect.
